g.text: Entry points
Core
State
External
gradlew · wrapper pinned to 5.4.1, a stray copy in the source tree pins 3.6.2
build.gradle · AGP 3.4.0, compile and target SDK 7, release signing config
gradle.properties · aapt2 off, cruncher off, sdk.dir is the Linux SDK
README.txt · a build journal, not documentation of the app
AndroidManifest · package java.hello, one launcher activity, no icon or theme
MainActivity · extends Activity, onCreate commented out, so the window is blank
Merged manifest · adds uses-sdk 7 and debuggable, keeps the package
Package mismatch · manifest java.hello, code hello, so the launcher class is missing
build/ · 100 plus tracked intermediates, generated R and BuildConfig, class files
.gradle/ · three committed caches, 4.4.1, 5.4.1, 7.5.1, one inside the package folder
first-keystore · 2.5 KB key made 2020, valid to 2047, password in build.gradle
local.properties · sdk.dir points at this machine, /usr/lib/android-sdk
No APK · build/outputs holds only the two merger reports
Android SDK · platform android-7, build-tools 27 and 30, platform-tools
AAPT2 · will not run on arm or arm64, so aapt2 and the cruncher are off
Gradle server · the wrappers download 5.4.1 and 3.6.2-all first run
